page.notes: Left edge strip (neighbouring page) and show-through omitted. Superscript mark before "Baronio" read as m; mark after "Caesar" as n; mark before "Seuerinus" as o. Several abbreviations (q with flourish, p-with-stroke forms before "eras" and "Indictiones", "q;" before "decepti") are read by best judgement and may be doubtful. "conuassauit" is a doubtful reading. The last line "ta-" is read as a catchword, though it stands in the text block. Running head taken as "Lib. III. Scutum Regium.", with the number 205 at the top right.
